component_references.claim_ceiling: Spectral-Strang distribution-space prototype with complex electric-mode diagnostics, x/v spectral-tail monitoring and a periodic Fourier zero-padding interpolation oracle. Nineteen tests passed on a preceding exact head; latest iterator/format fixes and t=10 trace are queued for exact-head validation. Not yet L3-admitted.
Diagnostic-only x/v high-frequency and Nyquist energy fractions. Not a truncation-error certificate and not an adaptive expansion policy.
Standalone trigonometric interpolation transfer oracle only. Does not mutate Vlasov state, choose an adaptive trigger or certify physical validity of grid expansion.

moments.caveat: Signed delta-f moments are signed contributions and are not automatically positive physical energies.

phase_space_mmd.caveat: Distribution discrepancy only; not a field, force, trajectory, or physical-error certificate.

phase_space_w1.applicability: nonnegative measures with equal total mass under the frozen periodic-cylinder ground metric
phase_space_w1.caveat: Signed delta-f is unsupported; unequal mass is rejected unless a separately defined unbalanced metric is added.

field_constraint.operator_binding: The residual must be computed by the exact field operator used in this segment.
field_constraint.caveat: Do not transfer a residual/error certificate across a stencil, gauge, boundary, norm, or dimensionality change.

required_properties: all mandatory metrics are independently within their justified tolerance
all observations match the same run, input, config and trajectory segment
operator identity, norm and units match the bound
calibration artifact matches the exact model and preprocessing digests
out_of_envelope states force fallback or unresolved

false_safe_reporting.note: Report exact binomial interval and effective independent trajectory count; seed replicates do not replace whole-regime holdouts.

performance_targets.acceptance_note: Speedup is reported only after equal physical fidelity and qualification coverage have been demonstrated on a named matched workload.

external_baselines.name: GEMPIC

external_baselines.name: Neural score-based Vlasov-Maxwell-Landau
external_baselines.admission_rule: Separate collisional cohort only; never pool its entropy or performance metrics into collisionless Vlasov-Poisson.

external_baselines.name: VlasovTT.jl tensor-train / MPS fully spectral Vlasov-Poisson
external_baselines.admission_rule: Reproduce both the paper's TT/MPS and dense-reference paths on identical initial conditions, grids, dt, precision and final time. Retain truncation-induced damping bias, negative distribution mass, rank history, TCI reconstruction cost and full runtime. Paper observations are not independently reproduced here.
external_baselines.reproduction_blocker: Both current repository scripts examples/landau_damping.jl and examples/reference_landau_damping.jl use A=0.1, while the paper specifies A=0.01. The reproduction must explicitly override A=0.01 for the paper-faithful lane and preserve A=0.1 as a separate source-default lane.

external_baselines.name: Adaptive Fourier spectral Vlasov-Poisson zero-padding method
external_baselines.admission_rule: Pin source revision and reproduce spectral-tail trigger, zero-padding, filter behavior and invariant claims on matched complete trajectories.

external_baselines.name: Positivity-preserving dynamical low-rank Vlasov
external_baselines.admission_rule: Compare on nonnegative distribution f only, preserving exact equation/cohort; do not impose positivity on signed delta-f states.

execution_receipt.state_correction_rule: Any correction invalidates state-dependent evidence from before the correction.

blocking_work: Admit and pin all component PRs and resolve branch stacking before code integration.
Implement a converged L3 distribution-space solver and independent convergence evidence.
Implement a trusted particle solver on identical initial conditions.
Freeze exact initial-condition parameters and numerical settings before scored runs.
Implement trajectory adapters, segment receipt emission and adversarial controller tests.
Reproduce external methods only after exact source/config/data admission.

representation_tournament.purpose: Compare dense spectral, adaptive Fourier zero-padding, TT/MPS, Fourier-Hermite, positivity-preserving low rank, particle-measure and learned field representations on one admitted 1D1V Vlasov-Poisson cohort.

new_research_comparators.name: Adaptive Fourier spectral Vlasov-Poisson
new_research_comparators.method: spectral-tail-triggered Fourier wavenumber-domain expansion by zero-padding

new_research_comparators.name: Positivity-preserving dynamical low-rank Vlasov
new_research_comparators.method: constrained quadratic-program correction of low-rank states; one scheme also preserves mass and momentum
new_research_comparators.applicability: nonnegative f only; signed delta-f needs another contract

representation_tournament.transition_rule: Any representation or resolution transition must have its own discrepancy, invariant, positivity/applicability and complete compute-cost receipt. No representation is permitted to claim correctness outside its qualified envelope.
representation_tournament.claim_ceiling: No universal winner or adaptive representation claim before matched-source reproduction and independent trajectory qualification.
